# Hotfix Justification

Use this when a HU uses the `hotfix` carril.

```md
## Hotfix Justification

- Change: <change-name>
- Reason: <why this cannot wait>
- User/business impact: <impact>
- Risk if delayed: <risk>
- Risk of hotfix: <risk>
- Approver: <approver>
- Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Reduced documentation accepted: yes | no
- Required validation before release: <checks>
- Follow-up normalization task: <task/change>
- Follow-up due date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
```

A hotfix may reduce documentation before execution, but it must not skip follow-up normalization.
